title: cacheSignal: cancel server work nobody will use

slides.say: A Server Component starts a slow fetch, but the render is aborted. Why keep waiting? Cache signal lets you cancel it.
During a render, cache signal returns an abort signal. Pass it to fetch. When React's render is over, the signal aborts, and the request stops.

slides.text: It aborts when rendering finishes: completed, aborted, or failed.
slides.say: Rendering counts as finished in three cases: it completed, it was aborted, or it failed.
Call it during render. At module level, outside rendering, it returns null, so nothing gets cancelled. It's for Server Components, and today it always returns null in Client Components.
